game.title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII
game.blurb: Turn-based 4X strategy game played across three ages, from Firaxis, released 2025-02-10. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genres: Strategy, Simulation. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1295660)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Sid_Meier's_Civilization_VII
Fandom (civilization.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://civilization.fandom.com/wiki/Civilization_VII
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0): only the "Table of Contents" subpage exists; "Walkthrough", "Gameplay", "Controls" and "Achievements and trophies" are linked but not written, so nothing was used. civilization.fandom.com redirects "Sid Meier's Civilization VII" to "Civilization VII", with about 252 linked pages, including "Age (Civ7)", "Antiquity Age (Civ7)", "Agenda (Civ7)" and leader pages such as "Augustus (Civ7)"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Happy Corner" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1295660 as "Sid Meier's Civilization® VII". None of the 47 Steam achievements is hidden, and none mentions multiplayer, although RAWG tags the game Multiplayer. 34 achievements are "win the modern age as" a leader; the last ten in the schema (Ada Lovelace, Simón Bolívar, Genghis Khan, Lakshmibai, Edward Teach, Sayyida al Hurra, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, Yi Sun-sin, George Washington, Elizabeth) each have an unlock rate of 0.4% or less and sit in their own chapter; they may come from later content, but nothing in the data says which. No achievement names the Modern Age triumphs.
